messages:
maya: Quick sync — ACME POC runway + owners. Need to lock SE coverage, security gating, and acceptance criteria by EOD tomorrow. Timeline target: 6 weeks. Can folks confirm owners and hard blockers?

jon-se: I can own SE delivery (onsite/remote). Need clarity on 3 things: primary use case, success metrics (quant), and eval harness.

maya: Primary use case is "support ticket summarization + suggested remediation" for 10k tickets/day. Success: 95% precision on suggested remediation in top-1 for flagged tickets and latency <= 300ms tail under 50 TPS for hosted runs. Also budget cap: <$Xk/month — will confirm exact number with finance.

tara-engr: Engineering support: we can allocate one senior infra engineer (tara-engr) for setup + 0.5 FTE for 3 weeks for integration work. Can cover model tweaks if we get prompt set early. Blocker: security questionnaire has a VPC requirement and uses customer-managed KMS. That will need infra lead.

darren-ps: For evals: suggest 2 prompt families: summarization (50 seed prompts) + remediation generation (30). We'll run an A/B vs current heuristic baseline. I'll prepare an automated eval script. Also propose pass/fail thresholds: top-1 remediation precision >= 0.65 and recall >= 0.5 (we can tune).

jon-se: Proposed high-level milestones:
```
Week 0 (2 business days): Kickoff + install access + security Q answered
Week 1-2: Data ingestion + prompt engineering + initial evals
Week 3: SE-led integration + performance tuning
Week 4: Scale testing + latency SLO verification
Week 5: Customer UAT + acceptance testing
Week 6: Handoff + runbook + cost analysis
```
Owners: maya (AE) - overall, jon-se (SE) - delivery, tara-engr - infra, darren-ps - evals, emily-devops - VPC/KMS provisioning.

emily-devops: I can provision a test VPC and stub KMS in 48 hours if legal signs off. Need SOC2 answers for their security questionnaire — which parts are non-negotiable?

maya: ACME insisted on SOC2 + encryption at rest and SPLIT-KEY KMS. They also want an audit log ingestion route. I'll attach their questionnaire to the thread (sent separately).

tara-engr: That's fine, but note: SPLIT-KEY adds ~3 business days for integration and key rotation scripting. Also region preference: eu-west-1. If they require on-prem air gap, that's a separate commercial.

darren-ps: Pricing question from procurement: what's the delta for Dedicated vs Hosted during POC? Quick reply: Hosted (metered) ~ baseline; Dedicated pilot (reserved) estimate adds ~30% uplift for dedicated GPU hours. I'll draft a short delta table and post.

maya: Please post the delta in this thread. Also confirm whether model fallback is automatic — customer wants graceful degradation to lower-cost variants if load spikes.

jon-se: Our routing supports fallback to smaller quantized variants; we'll include that in the runbook and set policy defaults (latency-priority vs cost-priority).

infra-bot: Reminder — resource reservation request queued (req-5234). ETA 48h.

maya: Next steps: darren - eval harness + thresholds by EOD today; emily - VPC provisioning ETA 48h; tara - infra prep & runbook draft by Monday; jon-se - integration plan and checklist by Monday. I'll consolidate and send a calendar invite for daily 30m standups.

jon-se: :thumbsup:

darren-ps: ack, will post eval link here.

emily-devops: ack, will start provisioning after legal sign-off.

maya: Thanks all — if anyone hits an unblocker ping me directly. We'll mark acceptance criteria as: remediation precision >= 0.65, tail latency <= 300ms at target throughput, and security checklist complete. If any of these fail, we'll have a go/no-go review end of Week 5. :rocket:
